topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: When we opened the will, the lawyer’s words hung in the air like a mist you can almost see but not quite touch. The house, the very same one where we spent weekends baking cookies and summer evenings chasing fireflies, was now ours. I hadn’t dared to imagine such a thing. It felt as if the world had tilted slightly on its axis, yet here we stood, my sister and I, custodians of a chapter of our history we thought was closed. The lawyer handed us a set of keys, and as I took them, a thousand memories flickered through my mind, each one more vivid than the last. What a turn of events, indeed.
